name: Minecraft: Java Edition
description: Minecraft Java server — Vanilla, Paper, Fabric, Forge or NeoForge — with one-click mods, plugins and modpacks from Modrinth and CurseForge, a live console and world backups.

variables.label: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Required by Mojang to run a server: https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA

variables.label: Server type
variables.description: Paper runs Bukkit/Spigot plugins; Fabric, Forge and NeoForge run mods.

variables.label: Minecraft version
variables.description: LATEST, SNAPSHOT, or a release such as 1.21.4. Must match the Java version below.

variables.label: Loader version
variables.description: Paper build, Fabric loader, Forge or NeoForge version. Leave blank for the newest stable one.

variables.label: Java version
variables.description: Java 25 for current releases, 21 for 1.20.5–1.21.x, 17 for 1.17–1.20.4, 8 for 1.16.5 and older (and old Forge).

variables.label: Message of the day
variables.description: Shown under the server name in the multiplayer list.

variables.label: Online mode
variables.description: Verify players against Mojang accounts. Turn off only for offline/LAN play.

variables.label: World seed
variables.description: Leave blank for a random world. Only used when the world is first generated.

variables.label: Extra JVM flags
variables.description: Space-separated, e.g. -XX:+UseZGC. The heap is already sized from the memory limit.

notes:
Runs on the [DeployKit Minecraft image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/minecraft-java), which downloads the server from Mojang, PaperMC, Fabric, Forge or NeoForge on the first start — so that one takes a minute or two.

- Install **mods** (Fabric/Forge/NeoForge) and **plugins** (Paper) from the **Mods** tab, or start the server from a Modrinth or CurseForge **modpack**, which then decides the Minecraft version and the loader. Required dependencies are installed with each mod. Jars uploaded by hand to `mods/` or `plugins/` are never touched.
- The settings on this page (MOTD, difficulty, max players, online mode…) are written into `server.properties` **on every start**, so change them here rather than in the file. Other properties you edit in the file are kept.
- The JVM heap is 75% of the memory limit; give the server more memory to raise it.
- The Java version must match the Minecraft version — also a modpack's. If it does not, the log says which one the server needs.
